title: Wire dashboard live sample actions
summary: Wired dashboard preview links into live fixture sample actions so fixture-backed animation rows can select their KaTeX sample surface from the agenda preview.

sourceRefs.summary: Fixture-backed animation preview links now carry the KaTeX fixture id needed to select the live sample.
Dashboard live-animation preview links now select the associated fixture, clear filters, unfold the agenda, and scroll to the sample layout.
Dashboard phase metadata records the live sample action slice and its verification hooks.
Node dashboard coverage asserts fixture-backed animation links expose sample fixture ids and records phase 8 completion.
Browser dashboard coverage clicks a preview link and verifies the linked KaTeX fixture sample becomes selected.
